question: What ritual sequence must follow the worship of the planets with their proper meditations?
premises: Each planet has its own prescribed meditation.
The lords of the directions are the next objects of worship.
inference: After worshipping the planets with their respective meditations, one should worship Indra and the other lords of the directions.
plain_english: Having worshipped the planets with their own meditations, one should then worship Indra and the other lords of the directions.
